faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Straight answers on the desk, the model, and what IRIS will not do.

items.whatA: IRIS Lab is a crypto market-intelligence desk. Live pulse, IRIS signals on the chart, market stance, news bullets, and an on-desk co-pilot — all tied to the market you have selected. You can browse the public desk without signing in.
items.signalsA: High-conviction setups marked on the chart with entry, stop, and target. Same model behind stance and the co-pilot — on the desk where you trade, not hidden in a feed.
items.chatbotA: No. IRIS is a desk model built for trading context. It reads tape, structure, funding, and news together, then returns a bracket: side, size, stop, and target. Built for the candle in front of you — not open-ended chat.
items.askQ: What can I ask the co-pilot?
items.askA: Anything about the active market: what to open, how to size it, where invalidation sits, or whether the setup still holds. IRIS answers with a plan you can read while the move is still live.
items.paperQ: Can I paper trade on IRIS Lab?
items.paperA: Yes. The paper desk fills against live prices — no wallet, no brokerage link. Test entries, sizing, and exits before you risk capital on your venue.
items.executeA: No. IRIS Lab does not route orders to an exchange or hold funds. Signals and co-pilot output are analysis. Where and whether you trade stays with you.
items.accountA: Not to browse. Open the public desk and read pulse, stance, and news without signing in. Connect an account for co-pilot chat, history, and plan limits on Free or Plus.
items.freeQ: How do Free and Plus differ?
items.freeA: Free is the full public desk with a daily co-pilot send cap and a weekly usage limit — enough to learn the flow. Plus raises both for traders who run the desk every session.
items.profitsA: No. Pulse, signals, and co-pilot replies support your process — they are not promises of return, win rate, or accuracy. IRIS Lab is analysis, not financial advice.
